description.value: Fox & Oak is a community coffee and bakehouse in downtown Squamish specializing in hand-crafted, naturally leavened doughnuts and specialty coffees. The focus on artisan techniques and natural leavening sets it apart from typical donut shops. Situated on Main Street at the gateway to some of BC's most popular mountain biking and road cycling routes, it makes a natural stop for cyclists passing through Squamish.
